claim: § The residual is where the soul hides: LPC-10 kept the formants, threw the residual away for a pulse train, and the voice went robotic; CELP brought the body back.

pieces.section: The residual is where the soul hides
pieces.what: One spoken phrase three ways: original, LPC filter driven by a pulse train, LPC filter driven by its own residual; then the residual alone.

pieces.section: The autoregressive model and the residual
pieces.what: Raise the order p from 1 to 20 and watch the residual shrink and hear what it holds.
pieces.walks_up_from: predicting a sine from its last sample

pieces.section: The source-filter model and its mirror-twin
pieces.what: The lattice and the waveguide drawn as one structure read from two ends.

note: Nothing to gather and no artifact; the central claim is audible and unheard. A vocoder voice must be one Loudon can publish.
